content.short: Context lets NFT traders track influencer wallet activity through a simplified interface.
content.description: Context is a blockchain application designed to help users monitor on-chain activity tied to NFT transactions. Unlike many wallet-monitoring tools that charge recurring fees, Context operates as a community-driven project and is offered free of charge. Through Context, NFT traders can observe the wallets of their preferred influencers, Twitter profiles, DAOs, or friends and place bids on NFT collections directly from the platform. The service also connects with Telegram and Discord to ensure timely, time-sensitive updates are delivered as they happen.
